pricing.title: Choose your Desktop plan
pricing.lead: All prices are in USD and include applicable taxes. Every plan includes a 7-day trial and local file processing. Personal covers one active device; Team covers up to five.
pricing.checkoutNote: Checkout is handled securely by Dodo Payments. Your license key is delivered after payment and can be pasted into Desktop.
pricing.keyEmail: Your license key is emailed to your checkout address. Check your Spam or Junk folder too.
pricing.deviceTitle: Need to move an occupied device?
pricing.deviceText: Device replacement starts inside Desktop and verifies the purchaser email before showing the one-time replacement checkout. Each plan card above shows its one-time replacement fee.
pricing.teamSeat: An unused Team seat activates without a replacement fee.

download.title: Download for your computer
download.lead: Choose the installer for your operating system. Every published file includes a SHA-256 checksum so you can verify the download before opening it.

windows.name: Windows
windows.req: Windows 11 or later on 64-bit Intel or AMD.

macos.name: macOS
macos.req: macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon or Intel. Ad-hoc builds require Open Anyway on first launch.

linux.name: Linux
linux.req: Ubuntu 22.04 or later on 64-bit Intel or AMD. Other distributions are not yet validated.

sysreq.title: System requirements
sysreq.lead: SoraFiles Desktop is designed to be lightweight and processes files locally. It works offline after setup.
sysreq.head: Requirement

rows.label: Memory
rows.value: No special requirement beyond what your operating system normally needs

rows.label: Storage
rows.value: Enough free space for SoraFiles and the files you work with

rows.label: Internet
rows.value: Needed for setup, activation and online services. File processing works offline

sysreq.note: Larger PDFs, images, or batch jobs may naturally use more memory and storage while processing.
sysreq.footnote: Windows uses Microsoft Edge WebView2. Linux packages target Ubuntu 22.04 x64. macOS first-launch approval steps are in

sections.title: Desktop guides
body: New to SoraFiles Desktop? These short guides explain what it is and how it works with your file manager.

sections.title: Installing Desktop
body: Download the installer for your operating system from {downloads}. Verify the published SHA-256 checksum before opening it. Desktop does not update itself automatically.

sections.title: Windows SmartScreen
body: The current Windows installer is distributed unsigned, so Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may say that Windows protected your PC. After verifying the SHA-256 checksum and confirming that you downloaded the installer from the SoraFiles release page, select More info, then Run anyway. A publisher warning may continue until SoraFiles ships a certificate-signed installer.

sections.title: Opening SoraFiles on macOS
body: The current Mac builds are ad-hoc signed and are not notarized by Apple. If macOS blocks the first launch, use these steps for a SoraFiles download you trust:
steps: Open the DMG, drag SoraFiles Desktop to Applications, then try opening it once.
Open System Settings, select Privacy & Security, and scroll to the message about SoraFiles Desktop.
Select Open Anyway, then confirm Open when prompted.
after: This approves the app on this Mac; it does not notarize it. If macOS reports that the app is damaged or will harm your computer, do not override that alert. See {apple}.

sections.title: Trial and activation
body: Your free 7-day trial begins automatically during Windows installation, or when you first open the app on macOS or Linux. To continue after the trial, choose License → Activate License and paste the key from your purchase email. Works offline after setup; file processing stays on your device.

sections.title: Can't find your license email?
body: Check the inbox for the email address used at checkout, including Spam or Junk. Look for “Your License Key is Ready” from {sender}. If it landed in Spam, mark it as not spam. If you still cannot find it, {contact} for help.

sections.title: Replacing a device
body: Open License → Replace device. SoraFiles sends a short-lived code to the purchaser email on the verified order. The address is masked in Desktop. After verification, the one-time replacement checkout opens; payment alone cannot bypass email verification.
after: An unused Team seat activates without a replacement fee.

sections.title: Where do I enter a promo code?
body: Enter a discount code in Dodo checkout before payment. SoraFiles Web remains free.

sections.title: Need to work on a file now?
body: {tools} remain available with no Desktop purchase required.

redeem.title: Redeem your invitation
redeem.lead: A giveaway code is an invitation. After verification, your license key activates Desktop on the devices included in your invitation.
redeem.closedText: Keep your invitation private and follow the instructions from SoraFiles when redemption opens. No code or payment is needed on this page today.
redeem.discount: Discount codes for a purchase belong in Dodo checkout. SoraFiles Web remains free.

open.notIncluded: Redemption isn’t included in this frontend prototype. Nothing was sent.
